nodes.title: The words-only distress read as a second read: positives on ordinary lines grok 4/2000, taxila-fast 3/2000, no overlap, all hand-read as lesson talk (a worry about being wrong, a story about anklet bells, 'main toh chhoti hoon, kya kar sakti hoon', a science answer about loneliness; chlorine, 'woh thak jaayega, gir jayega', 'Tiger!'). Added turn time: on grok p50 0 / p90 150 / max 1,114 ms (5/30 slowed; label p50 1,123, read p50 872); on taxila-fast p50 268 / p90 542 / max 986 ms (26/30 slowed). The 774 safeguard-turn lines are mostly replies inside an episode ('haan safe hoon'), so they measure nothing about recall.

14.3.2 (main safety review): a words-only distress read runs BESIDE the label call on every model-labelled turn (classify.js distressBeside, schema distress_beside, DEPLOY.classify first, two deployments at most, 3 s each); either read saying distress is distress (kind model, distressBy words, safety.scan source classify_words). A second read: a filter block moves on; blocked everywhere, the child's words alone decide (harm → distress, clear → no reading); a failure is no reading. It never removes distress and leaves the label call's fail-closed paths as they were. One words-alone probe per turn, shared. Why: the label call reads distress as one flag among the grading ones and missed low-mood lines on production's classifier that the words-only brief catches (ms-r1432-label-distress-miss); the cost is ~0.2% of ordinary turns flagged (released by the 14.3 model-episode release once the child says she is fine) and p90 +150 ms.
nodes.reversal: production (real lesson sids) shows classify_words safeguards on lesson talk above 0.5% of model-labelled turns, or the added turn time above 250 ms p90 on production; then gate the read on non-answer turns or tighten the brief, measured on the same 2,000 lines and the low-mood set

nodes.title: Tried (measured): the second distress read on taxila-fast, a different model family from the grok label call, for diversity. What broke: it is slower than the label call on most turns: added p50 268 / p90 542 ms, 26/30 turns slowed (n=30). Its precision was the same as grok's (3 vs 4 per 2,000). The read runs on DEPLOY.classify first.

Considered: run the second distress read only when the relational signals flag a low mood (loneliness, goodbye distress). What breaks: 'sab bekaar lagta hai' alone carries no relational signal, and it is the line the label call missed 0/6; any trigger narrower than every model-labelled turn reintroduces the miss.

md.measurements:
## ms-r1431-live (2026-10-15)

- **14.3.1 is live:** s3a18c0e-xvg1 at 100%, with 14.3 kept for rollback.
- Gate: 3,408 pass / 0 fail. Canary smoke 4/4.
- Live ack proof: one row per decision, codes only. Account deletion left 0 rows.

## ms-r1432-label-distress-miss (2026-10-15)

- On production's classifier (grok), the grading call flagged low-mood lines 34/48.
- 'sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta' was caught only 0/6 to 1/6.
- The words-only brief caught all six low-mood lines (30/30) and none of the boredom lines (0/20).

## ms-r1432-beside-fp-latency (2026-10-15)

- **False alarms:** the second read flagged 4/2,000 ordinary lines on grok and 3/2,000 on taxila-fast. All were lesson talk.
- **Turn time:** on grok it added p50 0 ms / p90 150 ms. On taxila-fast it added p50 268 ms / p90 542 ms.
md.decisions:
## dc-r1432-distress-beside (2026-10-15)

- **What:** a words-only distress read now runs beside the grading call on every graded turn. Either one saying distress is distress. It never removes distress, and the existing fail-closed paths are unchanged.
- **Why:** the grading call misses low-mood lines on production's model that the words-only read catches.
- **Cost:** about 0.2% of ordinary turns flagged, which the model-episode release ends quickly, and p90 +150 ms.
- **Reversal:** on production, false flags on lesson talk above 0.5% of graded turns, or more than 250 ms added at p90.
md.rejected:
## rj-r1432-beside-on-taxila-fast (2026-10-15)

- **Tried:** the second read on taxila-fast, for model diversity.
- **What broke:** it added p50 268 ms / p90 542 ms to the turn.

## rj-r1432-beside-on-relational-trigger (2026-10-15)

- **Considered:** running the read only when a low-mood signal fires.
- **What breaks:** the missed line carries no such signal.
